wish: someone should make a tool that compares two lists of words, one per line
spec:
Compares two pasted lists, one item per line, in any order, and shows what is only in A, only in B and in both, with counts.
Paste into the two boxes; results update as you type; toggle case, swap sides, copy any result column.
It does not diff line order or partial matches; blank lines and surrounding spaces are ignored and duplicates are counted once.
notes: Clipboard copy may be unavailable in some embedded contexts; button shows 'copy failed' then.
